title: OKF Feature Registry Schema
description: Validation schema for canonical feature identity and version lineage registry in OKF.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the feature registry schema.

document_id.description: Unique identifier of the source document (e.g. OKF-0002 or client_requirements_v1).

document_name.description: Human-readable filename of the source document.

section_id.description: Section identifier within the source document.

section_title.description: Section heading title within the source document.

page.description: Page number within the source document if known.

supersedes.description: List of version numbers or feature IDs superseded by this entity.

superseded_by.description: List of version numbers or feature IDs that supersede this entity.

version.description: Semantic version identifier for this requirement revision.

approval_status.description: Authority approval state of this specific version.

lifecycle_status.description: Lifecycle state of this specific version.

superseded_reason.description: Explanation of why this version was superseded or upgraded.

sources.description: Document and section provenance for this version.

spec.description: Structured specifications, parameters, or invariant requirements.

canonical_name.description: Human-readable canonical name of the feature.

domain.description: Feature domain classification (e.g. core_platform, copilot, audio).

description.description: Short summary of the feature's architectural role.

aliases.description: Alternative names used in conversations, notes, or tickets.

keywords.description: Deterministic lookup keywords associated with this feature.

project_id.description: Optional project scoping identifier (null for global).

current_approved_version.description: SemVer of the currently active approved version.

approval_status.description: Overall approval state of the feature.

lifecycle_status.description: Overall lifecycle state of the feature.

sources.description: Source document and section provenance for the active feature definition.

versions.description: Registered version history and lineage records.
